user.title: Fluidra connection type
user.description: Choose whether Home Assistant should use the local Fluidra bridge or connect directly to Fluidra cloud.

local.title: Fluidra Local Server
local.description: Local mode talks to your local Fluidra server/bridge. If a bridge broadcasts _fluidra-local._tcp.local, Home Assistant auto-fills the URL. The local server must be running and reachable from Home Assistant before setup can continue.

cloud.title: Fluidra Cloud
cloud.description: Cloud mode connects directly to Fluidra cloud using your Fluidra account. The device is detected automatically after login. Use Local mode for the Proxmox bridge.

cloud_device.title: Choose Fluidra device
cloud_device.description: Your Fluidra account has more than one device. Choose which one Home Assistant should configure.
